name: Truncated Text
description: Clamps text to one or more lines with a show more/less toggle and a tooltip for the full text.
usage:
<TruncatedText
  text="The full audit summary that may not fit..."
  lines={3}
/>

anatomy.description: The content ellipsized to one line or clamped to the configured number of lines.
The Show more/Show less control with aria-expanded, rendered only when text overflows.
The native title carrying the complete text while clamped.

dos: Set lines to match the height budget of the card or row.
Let the built-in measurement decide; the toggle appears only when text actually truncates.
Keep the full text reachable in place rather than linking away.
donts: Don't truncate code; use CodeBlock with scrolling instead.
Don't hide critical errors or actions behind truncation.
Don't add your own tooltip on top; the title already exposes the full text.

examples.title: Single line
examples.description: Ellipsizes text that overflows a narrow container and offers a Show more toggle plus a native title tooltip.

examples.title: Multi-line clamp
examples.description: Clamps a paragraph to three lines using the lines prop before offering expansion.

guidance.useWhen: Long user-generated text must fit a fixed-height region such as a card, table cell, or feed item, with an in-place way to read the rest.
guidance.avoidWhen: The full text is short or always visible; a plain element avoids the measurement overhead. For code, use CodeBlock with scrolling instead.
guidance.behavior: Measures overflow with scrollWidth/scrollHeight and only renders the toggle when the text actually truncates; while collapsed the full text is available as a title tooltip, and the toggle button reflects its state with aria-expanded.
guidance.responsive: Re-measures through ResizeObserver, so resizing the container re-evaluates whether truncation and the toggle are needed.

keyboard.action: Toggles between the clamped and expanded text.

notes: The toggle button sets aria-expanded and keeps its label in sync (Show more / Show less).
The full text is exposed as a title tooltip while clamped; consider repeating critical content elsewhere since title is not reachable by touch or keyboard alone.

props.description: Maximum number of visible lines before the text clamps.
props.name: lines

props.description: Label for the button that collapses the text.
props.name: showLessLabel

props.description: Label for the button that expands the text.
props.name: showMoreLabel
